# packages/graph/scripts

Directory houses TCK compliance audit tooling. `tck-audit.ts` identifies re-enable candidates among skipped tests via temporary unskip→run→restore cycle.

## Contents

### Audit Scripts

- **[tck-audit.ts](./tck-audit.ts)** — Discovers `test.skip` declarations in TCK suites, executes trial runs with temporary unskips, categorizes failures. Exports `main()`, `findTestFiles()`, `extractSkippedTests()`, `tryRunTest()`, `applyUnskips()`, `generateReport()`.

## Behavioral Contracts

**Skip Detection Regex:** `` `/test\.skip\s*\(\s*["'`](.+?)["'`]/` `` extracts declarations from `.test.ts` files. Skip reason parsing splits on last occurrence of `" - "` delimiter.

**Test Pattern Escaping:** `testName.replace(/[[\]()]/g, "\\{{CONTENT}}")` escapes bracket characters for vitest `-t` filter compatibility.

**Path Constants:** `TCK_DIR` resolves to `../src/test/tck` relative to script location via `path.join(import.meta.dirname, "../src/test/tck")`. `REPORT_PATH` outputs to `../TCK_AUDIT_RESULTS.md`.

**Categorization Heuristics:**
- `DESIGN_EXCLUSIONS`: `"unlabeled node"`, `"unlabeled nodes"`, `"multi-label"`, `"multi label"`, `"multiple labels"`, `"label removal"`, `"REMOVE n:Label"`, `"remove label"` → category `"design"`
- `NOW_WORKING_PATTERNS`: `"count(*)"`, `"count(\\*)"`, `"parameters not supported"`, `"parameter syntax"`, `"$param"`, `"RETURN-only"`, `"return-only"`, `"temporal"`, `"date()"`, `"time()"`, `"datetime()"`, `"duration()"`, `"ORDER BY alias"`, `"order by alias"`, `"toBoolean"`, `"startNode"`, `"endNode"`, `"id()"`, `"elementId()"`, `"type()"`, `"labels()"`, `"properties()"`, `"keys()"`, `"range()"`, `"reverse()"`, `"head()"`, `"tail()"`, `"last()"`, `"coalesce()"`, `"WITH...MATCH"`, `"named path"` → category `"now_working"`

**Vitest Invocation:** `npx vitest run <relativePath> -t <pattern> --reporter=basic` with env `CI: "true"`. Timeout: 30000ms.

## CLI Interface

`tck-audit.ts` accepts:
- `--dry-run`: Parse-only reporting without test execution
- `--file=<path>`: Target single file instead of full directory scan
- `--apply`: Persist successful unskips to source files via batch replacement

## Workflow Conventions

**Offset-Prevention Sort:** `applyUnskips()` sorts `TestResult[]` descending by `lineNumber` before executing `test.skip`→`test` replacements. Prevents line number drift during multi-edit operations.

**Restore Guarantee:** `tryRunTest()` wraps file rewrite and vitest spawn in `try...finally` block. Original `test.skip` content restores via `fs.writeFileSync` in `finally` even on spawn failure, timeout, or process error.

**Skip Format Convention:** Test declarations follow `Test Name - Skip Reason` pattern. Audit splits on last `" - "` to separate test name from skip reason string.
